scientific.integrity: Exchangeability and the unit-sum simplex constraint force the weight covariance to be a scalar multiple of the projector orthogonal to the all-ones vector. Pushing this covariance through the task-gradient matrix gives the exact centered scatter operator, and the simplex coordinate bound gives the sharp one-hot maximum.
limitations: Conditional on fixed task gradients; mini-batch data noise is excluded.
Instantaneous second-order statement rather than a convergence or generalization theorem.
Higher moments can differ even when covariance eigendirections coincide.

title: RLW noise is exactly the task-gradient scatter matrix
